Headline: #20 Madison buses Temporary Reroute near Madison/Racine
ShortDescription: #20 Madison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near Madison/Racine.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#20 Madison buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to construction near Madison/Racine.

Eastbound buses will operate via Madison, Racine, Jackson, Morgan, Madison and over normal route.

Westbound buses will operate via Madison, Morgan, Van Buren, Racine, Madison and over normal route.

Allow extra travel time.
